integrity: All general claims are supported by a finite-state proof and extremal gap classification. Exact finite checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-label weight enumeration applies only to labelled simple cycles; no formula for optimal three-label assignments on odd cycles or for dihedral equivalence classes. Previous additive chromatic numbers of cycles are credited. Historical-priority assessment remains qualified; no independent audit performed.
title: Complete binary additive-colouring spectrum of labelled cycles
